resources.string: SOSMesh is not a replacement for 112. Always call 112 in emergencies.
Bluetooth: SOSMesh uses Bluetooth Low Energy to share SOS messages with nearby devices without internet. Without this permission, mesh scan cannot start.
Location (legacy scan): On Android 11 and below, BLE scanning may require location permission.
Notifications: Optional alerts when your SOS status changes.
No guarantee of continuous background connection or rescue.
